subject: Request to substitute an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping

messages.text: We're proposing an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping specified in Section 22 13 16 and want sign-off before we order material. This is becoming a priority given current supplier lead times. There could be a cost adjustment tied to this substitution. No schedule impact is anticipated from this substitution. A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.

The submittal for an ABS DWV alternate in lieu of the no-hub cast-iron soil piping specified in Section 22 13 16 is acceptable provided it shows equivalent performance data and code-compliance listings for the assembly it replaces. There could be a cost adjustment tied to this substitution.
